name: uni-t-uts-mcp
description: MCP server for UNI-T UTS series spectrum analyzers via SCPI over LAN
long_description: Lets Claude read and set a UNI-T UTS1000B/UTS3000B spectrum analyzer over your local network: frequency, amplitude, bandwidth, sweep, detector and traces. Enter the analyzer address in the settings, or leave it empty and ask Claude to connect to the analyzer at an address. The analyzer must be reachable on your network (raw SCPI, TCP port 5025). Nothing leaves your computer except the connection to the analyzer.

tools.name: connect
tools.description: Connect to the analyzer by address (raw, VXI-11 or auto transport).

tools.name: discover_instruments
tools.description: Find analyzers on your local network without knowing their address (read-only).

tools.name: disconnect
tools.description: Disconnect from the analyzer.

tools.name: identify
tools.description: Read the analyzer identification: manufacturer, model, serial number and firmware.

tools.name: scpi_query
tools.description: Send one raw SCPI query and return the reply.

tools.name: scpi_command
tools.description: Send a raw SCPI command, synced and checked for instrument errors.

tools.name: get_frequency
tools.description: Read center, span, start, stop and center step frequency.

tools.name: set_frequency
tools.description: Set center, span, start, stop or center step frequency.

tools.name: get_amplitude
tools.description: Read reference level, power unit, scale per division and attenuation.

tools.name: set_amplitude
tools.description: Set reference level, power unit, scale per division or attenuation.

tools.name: get_bandwidth
tools.description: Read resolution and video bandwidth, their ratio and the filter shape.

tools.name: set_bandwidth
tools.description: Set resolution and video bandwidth, their ratio or the filter shape.

tools.name: get_sweep
tools.description: Read sweep time, sweep type, sweep points and trigger settings.

tools.name: set_sweep
tools.description: Set sweep points, sweep time, sweep type or trigger settings.

tools.name: get_detector
tools.description: Read the detector of one trace or of all six traces.

tools.name: set_detector
tools.description: Set the detector of one trace.

tools.name: get_acquisition
tools.description: Read whether the analyzer sweeps continuously or runs a single sweep.

tools.name: set_acquisition
tools.description: Switch between continuous sweep and single sweep mode.

tools.name: start_sweep
tools.description: Start or restart a sweep.

tools.name: single_sweep
tools.description: Run exactly one sweep and wait until it is complete.

tools.name: wait_for_sweep_complete
tools.description: Wait for a sweep started with start_sweep to finish.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the analyzer screen as a PNG image (needs the VXI-11 transport).

tools.name: get_trace
tools.description: Read the configuration of one or all traces.

tools.name: set_trace
tools.description: Select the current trace and set the type and options of a trace.

tools.name: restart_trace
tools.description: Restart max hold, min hold or averaging.

tools.name: set_trace_math
tools.description: Set trace math: a result trace from two operand traces.

tools.name: get_trace_data
tools.description: Read a trace's amplitude values with the frequency axis, unit and summary statistics.

tools.name: get_marker
tools.description: Read a marker's mode, trace, frequency and level.

tools.name: set_marker
tools.description: Set a marker's mode, trace, reference marker or position.

tools.name: marker_search
tools.description: Move a marker to the peak, next peak, minimum or peak-to-peak.

tools.name: marker_to_instrument
tools.description: Set center, step, start, stop or reference level from a marker.

tools.name: markers_all_off
tools.description: Turn all markers off.

tools.name: get_peak_criteria
tools.description: Read the peak search threshold and excursion.

tools.name: set_peak_criteria
tools.description: Set the peak search threshold and excursion.

tools.name: get_measurement
tools.description: Tell whether the analyzer is in spectrum analyzer mode, or check one measurement and read its parameters.

tools.name: configure_measurement
tools.description: Enter channel power, time-domain power or OBW and set its parameters.

tools.name: read_measurement
tools.description: Read the result of the active channel power, time-domain power or OBW measurement.

tools.name: exit_measurement
tools.description: Leave the measurement and restore the saved frequency, bandwidth and sweep settings.

tools.name: measure
tools.description: One-shot channel power, time-domain power or OBW measurement that restores the analyzer afterwards.

host.title: Analyzer address
host.description: Hostname or IP address of the analyzer on your network, for example 192.168.1.100. Optional: leave it empty and ask Claude to connect to the analyzer at an address instead.

port.title: Port
port.description: TCP port of the raw SCPI connection. The analyzer uses 5025; change it only if you know yours differs.

transport.title: Transport
transport.description: How to talk to the analyzer: auto (the default: VXI-11 when the analyzer offers it, otherwise raw), raw (TCP port 5025) or vxi11. Enter one of: auto, raw, vxi11.
